items.title: 13.2.2 Problems and Methods of Osmoregulation (Roman Urdu)

blocks.caption: Teen maskanon mein osmoregulation
rows: janwar hypertonic: pani osmosis se (khaas taur par gills se) andar aata aur Na+ aur Cl- jaise namak bahar nikalte hain
bohat sa patla peshab; namak active transport se wapas; kam hi pani peena
haddi wali machhliyan hypotonic: pani gills aur jild se nikalta, aur namak andar aata aur nigle samundari pani ke saath aata hai
samundari pani peena; thora gaarha peshab; gills ke chloride cells ATP se namak bahar nikalte; gurde namak nikalte; kuch mein rectal salt glands
saans ki sateh, jild aur fuzlaat se bukhaarat ke zariye pani zaya hota hai

pani-band ghilaaf (insects mein chitin aur moom, reptiles mein keratin ke chhilke, parindon aur mammals mein keratin wali jild aur tel ke glands); pani bachane wale gurde; ammonia ki bajaye urea ya uric acid; din mein zameen ke andar rehne jaisa rawayya

blocks.text: Kai registani janwar din ki garmi mein zameen ke andar rehte aur raat ko nikalte hain jab hawa thandi aur zyada nam hoti hai, aur carbohydrate se bharpoor beej khate hain. Kangaroo rat sirf metabolic pani par, jo cellular respiration ka zimni nateeja hai, zinda reh sakta hai.

Kuch invertebrates jaise tardigrades (water bears) jism ka taqreeban tamam pani kho kar anhydrobiosis naam ki khwabeeda halat mein chale jate hain, aur saalon baad pani milne par dobara sargarm ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: meethe pani ki machhli jis mein pani andar aata, bohat sa patla peshab nikalta aur namak active transport se liya jata hai. Oopar daen: samundari haddi wali machhli jis se pani nikalta, samundari pani piya jata, thora gaarha peshab aur chloride cells namak bahar nikalte hain. Neeche baen: ammonia, urea aur uric acid aur fi gram taqreeban 500, 50 aur 1 mL pani bars ki shakal mein. Neeche daen: zyada garmi aur thand mein insani rad-e-amal.
blocks.caption: Osmoregulation, nitrogeni fuzlaat aur insani thermoregulation (topics 13.2 aur 13.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Meethe pani ki machhli apne aas paas ke pani se zyada namkeen hoti hai, to pani osmosis se andar aata rehta aur namak bahar nikalta hai; yeh bohat sa patla peshab banati, namak active transport se wapas leti aur kam hi pani peeti hai. Samundari haddi wali machhli samundari pani se kam namkeen hoti hai, to pani khoti aur namak hasil karti hai; yeh samundari pani peeti, thora gaarha peshab banati aur gills ke chloride cells se namak bahar nikalti hai. Ammonia ko mehfooz taur par nikalne ke liye fi gram taqreeban 500 mL pani, urea ko 50 mL aur uric acid ko 1 mL chahiye, to pani ki kami wale janwar urea ya uric acid nikalte hain. Insani jism zyada garam ho to jild ki nalyan phailti aur paseena thanda karta hai; zyada thanda ho to nalyan sukarti, muscles kaanpte aur baal khare hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Meethe pani ki machhli patla aur samundari haddi wali machhli gaarha peshab kyun banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Meethe pani ki machhli osmosis se pani hasil karti rehti aur izafi pani nikalna parta hai; samundari machhli pani khoti rehti aur har qatra bachana parta hai, to thora, gaarha peshab nikalti hai.

items: Meetha pani: pani milta, namak jata, patla peshab. Samundar: pani jata, namak aata, peena aur namak nikalna. Zameen: pani-band ghilaaf aur pani bachane wala ikhraj.
